title: Anchor-based quantization validator with synthetic perturbation cohorts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated validator that exercises quantized model variants (FP8 and INT8) against a dynamic set of golden prompts and synthetic perturbation cohorts. The validator uses an anchor-based approach: maintain a small set of "anchor" (full-precision) responses for reference, generate synthetic perturbations (typos, paraphrases, context-length variants, adversarial token masking), and replay them deterministically against quantized candidates. Cohorts are weighted by production query distributions to surface realistic regressions. The harness supports per-layer sensitivity toggles, cohort prioritization, and multi-threshold pass/fail gates (accuracy delta, KL divergence, and structural output checks). Intended to be used in CI and rollout canaries.
acceptance_criteria: CI job runs end-to-end within 90 minutes for full 10k sample golden set and finishes within 15 minutes for the smoke cohort (500 samples).
False-positive regression rate <= 1% on smoke cohort over 30 runs.
Per-model pass/fail gates configurable per release and stored in the results index.
Automated report written to S3/GCS with actionable diffs (anchor vs candidate) and links to PRs/dashboards.
Integrates with rollout pipeline: failures block canary promotions via console webhook.
steps: Design: define anchor selection algorithm and cohort generators (synthetic perturbations, paraphrase model configs).
Data: curate golden prompts and production-weighted sampling plan; implement synthetic perturbation scripts.
Runtime: extend evaluation runner to load quantized variants, run deterministic seed-based replay, capture token-level traces and structured outputs.
Analysis: implement metric calculators, cohort weighting, and pass/fail gate logic.
Integration: CI job, console webhook, and storage of per-run artifacts.
Rollout: add canary gating hook to deployment orchestrator and playbook for triage.

risks: Synthetic perturbations may not cover rare real-world failure modes; plan to include production replay samples.
Full 10k run requires significant GPU runtime; may increase CI costs if not optimized with caching/batching.
Per-layer sensitivity toggles complicate result interpretation and require clear defaults to avoid alert fatigue.
decisions: Use anchor-based reference instead of ensemble baseline for simpler diffing.
Store all run artifacts in compressed parquet format to reduce storage footprint.
Thresholds: initial gate set to 1.5% top1 accuracy delta or KL > 0.12 for blocking canary.
